cite.search: Search author, title, year or key
cite.noLibrary: No sources yet: add a .bib or .csl.json file to the vault, or copy your Zotero library (desktop app).
cite.synced: Zotero library copied into the vault: {n} sources.
cite.zotero.disabled: Zotero's local API is off. In Zotero: Settings → Advanced → "Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero".
cite.zotero.notRunning: Zotero isn't running on this computer. Open Zotero 7 and try again.
cite.zotero.browser: Zotero only answers apps on this computer, not web pages: copy the library from the desktop app.
cite.web.keyBody: Lumen reads your Zotero library from api.zotero.org with a key you create at zotero.org → Settings → Security → Applications (read-only library access is enough). The key stays in this device's secret store and is sent only to api.zotero.org; every request shows in the privacy ledger. Nothing is written to Zotero.
cite.web.synced: Zotero library synced from zotero.org: {n} sources ({changed} changed, {deleted} removed, {notes} notes).
cite.web.upToDate: The Zotero library is up to date ({n} sources).
cite.web.forbidden: Zotero refused the key. Run the sync again and enter a key from zotero.org → Settings → Security → Applications.
cite.web.noAccess: This key can't read your library: edit it on zotero.org and allow library access.
cite.web.rateLimited: Zotero asked to slow down; try again in a few minutes.
cite.web.blocked: The AI and privacy policy is local-only, so Lumen doesn't contact zotero.org.
